testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/my-account/order-template-validate-quantity-and-total.spec.ts > Webstore - My Account - Order Template > validate quantity and total behavior

scenario.summary: The signed-in user checks that an existing template name is rejected, creates a uniquely named template with a simple product (quantity rules 1-10, line total = qty x price), finds and edits it, moves it to the cart and sets the cart quantity, then creates a second template with the simple product and a bundle, removes a line, and finally deletes every template matching the runtime name.
steps: Open Order Templates; Create; name = an existing template's name; add the simple product (search '09876') quantity 1; Save: 'Template Name already exists.'
Reload; unique runtime name; add z-09876; quantity 11 -> exceeding message, 0 -> 'Enter valid quantity.', 1 -> added; line quantity 11 -> exceeding message, back to 1; Save: saved toast
Search junk -> 'No records found.'; search the runtime name -> row present
Edit: product name visible; total = qty x price; quantity 5; total = qty x price; Save
Move the template to cart: cart line 'SKU: z-09876'; cart quantity 10
Best-effort max-cart-quantity message when adding the SKU again
Create '<runtime>_Bundle' with the simple product and the bundle; Save: saved toast
Open it: bundle and simple product names visible; remove the first line: deleted toast
Search 'Runtime Order Template', select all, delete: confirm text, deleted toast, no records
stateChanges: Creates two order templates on the signed-in account (runtime name and runtime name + '_Bundle')
Deletes every template of the account whose name matches 'Runtime Order Template' (its own and any left by earlier runs)
The account's cart: filled by Move To Cart (quantity 10), then emptied
assertions: Quantity validations: above max (message names the range 1 to 10) and below min
Saved / deleted toasts and no-records text
Line total equals quantity x price before and after the update
Cart line shows 'SKU: <sku>' and the set quantity
Bundle template lists the bundle and the simple product
evidence: Title 'validate quantity and total behavior' matches the 10 steps; no linked AIO cases; all data through loadData (spec line 35)

DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec runs in the webstore-auth project (playwright.testim-webstore.config.ts AUTH_SPECS = my-account/**) on the shared storageState written by testim-migrated/tests/auth.setup.ts, which signs in with getMyAccountUser() (src/data/credentials.ts) = loadEnvironment().myAccountUser, username from env var MY_ACCOUNT_USERNAME (src/config/env.ts:80, process.env / .env.<env>). The migrated test declares that same account at test start: await testData.useExisting('user', getMyAccountUser().username). The credential source points at that env var (no value stored). Caveat: all 20 webstore-auth specs share this one account; declaring it leases it per test, so tests that declare it run one at a time (leaseWaitMinutes 10) - reviewer to confirm that serialisation is wanted (it also prevents the template/order count collisions noted here)

OWNERSHIP: the duplicate-name check needs a template named testimTemplate ('Testim Order Template') owned by the signed-in account; the cleanup deletes the account's templates matching 'Runtime Order Template'. MISSING KEY: no order-template key (proposed ORDER_TEMPLATE_OF_USER, entity order with ClassCode OrderTemplates: params owner (link @user.userId), store, minTemplates, maxTemplates optional; outputs templateName, templateNumber, quantity, templateCount). testimTemplate is recorded as expected-output only because a data source needs a declared alias; it is really data of that need (output templateName)

product: PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK (outputs sku, name, maxQuantity). The quantity rules depend on the product: the message 'Selected quantity should be in between 1 to 10', invalidHighQuantity 11 and cartQuantity 10 follow from its maximum quantity 10; minMaxQuantity 10 and quantityUsed 10 (cart quantity). The migrated spec must derive 11 and the message's range from maxQuantity, so these stay expected-output/config today but depend on the data (swap rule fails)
sku '09876' is the autocomplete search text for z-09876 (the SKU without its 'z-' prefix): data of alias product with no output of its own (derive it from sku)

SCANNER GAP: productName, bundleProductName and bundleChildProductName (JSON lines 22-24, used in productNames.filter({ hasText })) were not in the scan; added here from the data file. bundleChildProductName equals the simple product's name (the bundle template holds the simple product and the bundle), so it maps to product.name; reviewer to confirm it is not meant to be the bundle's child (bundle.child1Name)

bundle: PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK (outputs sku, name); profile: z-2252025 BundleProduct 'Auto_DeWalt 3-Tool Combo Kit Bundle' active PRODUCTION, inventory 9999990; recorded bundleProductName is a substring of it
Collision risk: creates/deletes templates on the shared account while order-templates-validate-list-page-pagination-and-sorting counts them (totalTemplateCount 12)
migrate: derived quantity values, owner-linked template, and the user need (a swapped spec never declares an account)
